expected.notes: The brief states each doctor has two windows a day. Dr. Rao's Monday windows are 09:00-12:00 and 11:45-15:00, so he has no Monday evening; Dr. Sethi works Wednesday mornings only. An agent that trusts the brief over clinic.json invents a 17:00 slot on both days. Escalating is also wrong: nothing here needs a human.
